access_notes: Read 2026-10-30 (T-3250) through a fetch that returned the essay in summary and short quoted fragments, never a whole paragraph; cited only for what those fragments say.
note: Fragments read: Henrietta Greenebaum Frank (1608) and Ella Walker (1720) 'worked steadily for quality nursing education at the Illinois Training School for Nurses'; Jane Grahame Jones (1834) 'fought for woman suffrage.' The essay also says the residents supported the Visiting Nurses Association and helped found the Art Institute, and that after the 1890s many leading families died or moved to suburbs such as Lake Forest.
